useCases.title: One API in front of every provider dialect
useCases.summary: Chat Completions, Messages, and Responses on one key
useCases.problem: Apps accumulate one client per vendor. Failover and logging then live in your code instead of the gateway.

snippets.code:
curl https://anyrouter.dev/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ANYROUTER_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "anyrouter/auto",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Say hello in one sentence." }]
  }'
snippets.title: curl · anyrouter/auto

steps: Use https://anyrouter.dev/api for Anthropic /messages (Claude Code, Agent SDK).
Start with anyrouter/auto so the first request is not a single upstream.
